$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Loads for any session started in this repo — no
claude.ai connector settings, no per-surface toggling, nothing to remember.
AUTH: this server accepts EITHER '?key=<key>' in the URL (Claude Desktop,
ChatGPT — clients that cannot send custom headers) OR the 'x-brain-key'
header. Claude Code uses the HEADER form, which is what is configured here.
Note it is x-brain-key — NOT Authorization/x-api-key/apikey, none of which
The key is never stored here. ${OPEN_BRAIN_KEY} expands from the environment;
set it in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). See CLAUDE.md § Open Brain.
The expected value lives in the Supabase secret MCP_ACCESS_KEY on project
nscgwcepxnalchobgqhx. A 401 {"error":"Invalid or missing access key"} means
the two do not match — verified 2026-07-27 that the same 401 comes back for
the query-string form, the x-brain-key header, and no key at all.
